Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 87. Category: form. Legendary Grades.

You let the full power of your Super Saiyan without your
rage leaking out, but the muscle mass is far beyond
what you can control while in your controlled state
Increase your Power by 1
You deal an additional 1d6 to all damage
Decrease your Movement Speed by 30 ft.
You gain +2 Bulk
At the end of your turn, you lose 3 Stamina
